reviews.author: Allen Miller
reviews.text: Affordable prices and full hook-ups. 5-Stars would require better signage so if you arrive in the dark you could find the turns in the RV park without getting out with a flashlight.

reviews.author: Angilo Fletcher
reviews.text: Great location for a family camping trip. We took our family of 5 here with another family of 4. Lots of trails, beach access and more. We brought our boat and Kayaks and the water was amazing!

reviews.author: Steve McCollough
reviews.text: A good place for families. Lots of activities. However, my personal tastes are to camp in places with more space between campsights, and less people in general. Looks popular, though.

reviews.author: Don Lowe
reviews.text:
Spent a week in mid May and had great weather and great trout fishing. We stayed in the G loop and had wonderful views of the lake. The dogwoods were in bloom at this time of year.
The campground was full on the weekend but emptied out during the week.
The park hosts sell firewood and ice and there is a small store for snacks.

reviews.author: Christina Morgan
reviews.text: Mongold Dsy use was a great place to cool off. I dont have a boat or jet ski, but this place looks to be the hot spot. Get there early, whether for boating or sitting on the shore. The area is very rocky. I would suggest water shoes. Bring cover like an easy up or umbrella. It was only 75 but felt much hotter in the sun. The water was decent temp, and we could just hop in. It was a bit windy at times so hard to navigate in a tube alone (bring a paddle). There are a lot of areas along the water so people are spread out. There are only a few picnic tables. Personally, I like a river in which water is a bit clearer and the rocks are tumbled.

reviews.title: Camping at Detroit Lake State Park
reviews.author: anaklakay
reviews.text: If you are living in the beautiful city of Portland, Oregon, this is the most accessible place to camp out...Its an easy 1-1/2 hour southbound drive and scenic view after the city of Salem...Detroit Lake is a huge lake and its just great for boating, rafting, fishing, etc.-almost anything you can do where water is involved...Reserve your spot at least at the beginning of the year or you will be left out in a "waiting list" if there is one...Most of the campsites are close to the lake...Its always a winner to visit this place even for a day if you are not able to reserve your site...

reviews.author: Jill G
reviews.text: We loved this campground. Super clean, super safe and they have showers!!! The lake is absolutely beautiful and our campsite was just steps from the water. You can get wood and ice onsite so not necessary to go the store for those supplies. Town of Detroit is only two miles away, though, if you need something. Campsite are large enough for two 10 x 12 tents. Highly recommend to anyone.

reviews.title: Beautiful Lake, Great Fishing and Nice Full Service Camping Sites
reviews.author: oregon_or_bust
reviews.text: There are a lot of boats on the lake during the weekend and it make for an ocean lake experience if you like to waterski or tube, especially with smaller kids.

reviews.author: Wildtj65
reviews.text: We've camped at Detroit lake over a dozen times in the past 4 years! It's easy to see why the camp spots fill up quickly! We last visited in June (2015) and even though the lake was low, we still had a blast! There may be less water, but there's more beach! ;) We especially enjoyed walking along the pebbled trails and all the neat creatures that wandered into our camp! We were visited by squirrels, baby ducks, geese, and various birds including hummingbirds and a beautiful hawk! I suggest bringing a camera to capture the beautiful scenery like Mt Jefferson,Piety Island, and the forest! Also, the camp staff could not be more accommodating and friendly! I recommend going to as many of the camp activities as possible as they offer sing a longs, story telling, and wildlife movies and lectures! I thoroughly appreciated the rustic gift shop that offers ice, firewood & free coffee! We can't wait to go back in September, even though there is a campfire ban and even lower lake levels. Its the best place that I can think of to spent quality time with loved ones! I highly recommend Lake Detroit!

reviews.author: Dan_Clements
reviews.text: Tight spots questionable neighbors. No fires or even a lake. Was a little wanting charging as much as they did.

reviews.author: mini
reviews.text: We went for a day visit to Detroit Lake State Park. Detroit Lake is a beautiful large lake. There is a marina and it is a popular lake for boating. There is camping, swimming, fishing, hiking, bird watching, picnics, and more to do at this nice state park in Oregon

reviews.title: Camping
reviews.author: Fearless193602
reviews.text: Great place to camp but call ahead if desiring boating activities.

reviews.author: WeAlwaysWAnder
reviews.text: We were on a long road trip and planned on staying in one of the many forest service campgrounds in the area, but we got lucky and scored a last minute cancellation for a waterfront site at this huge state park. The park is very big.... about 300 sites. They are pretty close together, lacking privacy. It is fully booked all summer making it a busy place. Our site was F33 and it is one of the better ones in the park. It is a water view site with a game & play area between it and the water. Sites in the park range from nice and flat to mostly hilly, making parking an RV a harder task. The camp area is mostly forested but you still get some sunshine, and plenty of shade if you don't want sun. There are full, partial, and no hook up sites. Bathrooms with running water and free showers. There are sites that back up to the highway and I can only imagine those would be quite noisy, but ours was fairly peaceful. I think that most would give this state park a much higher rating, but it was just too busy and populated for our taste. It would be great for families, but not the best for a couple who are looking for some peaceful camping.

reviews.author: Stacy S
reviews.text: This was our first time camping at Detroit State Park. We enjoyed our three days there. We had so much to do from walking around parts of the lake to fishing. But most of all relaxing on the lake on and off our boat.

reviews.title: Great travel stop
reviews.author: JJ J
reviews.text: We come every year! I really hope they do not take all the water out of Detroit Lake for the next couple years like they are saying, it would destroy the town! It's a wonderful campground, beautiful lake, and great experience for the kids. Highly recommend if you like to RV camp!

reviews.author: rennolds52
reviews.text: The park hosts were great. Our site, however, had a problem with the 50 amp breaker and so we had no a/c in our motorhome on a hot day. The park hosts contacted maintenance, who did not show up until the next morning when we were leaving. No refund was stated to us. So, Park hosts, big thumbs up. Park maintenance, thumbs down. Oh, and the lake had algae warnings, too.

reviews.author: Greg C
reviews.text: I saw the beautiful photos of Detroit Lake, but when we got there we found what resembled a moonscape! The lake is so low it was more like a pond. The camps that facilitate RV's were closed (early). Huge mistake visiting the lake!!! Never again...

reviews.author: 90Linda
reviews.text: Nice camp ground get your reservation early though because the word got out how amazing this is. Its relaxing and beautiful.

reviews.author: leanna1963
reviews.text: We had a great time, the host were all pleasant. The showers are a little work pushing the button to keep the water coming out. It depended on which one you were in
